name: @oge-ui/react-tree-list
description: React tree list (hierarchical data grid) from the OGE UI suite: flat parentId or nested data, lazy per-expansion child loading with remote match discovery, ancestor-preserving filtering (filter row, header filter, search, filter builder), sibling-scoped sorting, recursive tri-state selection, paging over the visible rows, row and column virtualization, editing in all five modes, drag and drop reparenting, treegrid keyboard navigation, keyboard context menus, pinned/resizable/reorderable columns and bands, state persistence and CSV/Excel export — running the same framework-free tree engine, the same grid state slices and the same stylesheet as the Angular tree-list package.
author: kaya2m
